fix_subject: Rebind empty result columns when deep copying a plan
pr_title: inlining a CTE used twice renumbers each copy's columns, but a branch

labels.summary: When a plan containing an empty-result operator is deep copied (for example, when a CTE used twice is inlined), the copy keeps the original table indices for its empty-result bindings while other operators get renumbered, so the copied columns no longer match their references.
